# uptimepage_monitor_group (Data Source)

Look up a monitor group by name, such as one made in the app or by a monitor's `group_name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A group made in the app, or by a monitor's group_name.
data "uptimepage_monitor_group" "dns" {
  name = "example.com DNS"
}

resource "uptimepage_target" "mx" {
  name     = "example.com MX"
  interval = 300
  group_id = data.uptimepage_monitor_group.dns.id
  check = {
    type = "dns"
    dns = {
      domain      = "example.com"
      record_type = "MX"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, matched exactly after trimming.

### Read-Only

- `alert_again` (Boolean)
- `alert_as_one` (Boolean) Whether the group pages as one.
- `id` (String) Group id (UUID), for a target's `group_id`.
- `member_count` (Number) Monitors in the group.
- `renotify_interval_secs` (Number)
- `tags` (Set of String)
